propositions: CodeQL workflow previously ran on every push to main plus a weekly schedule (23 4 * * 1), but the push trigger was removed in commit 03ef leaving the weekly cron as the primary scan of newly-landed code rather than a between-pushes backstop

A newly-introduced SAST finding could remain unscanned for up to 7 days under the weekly-only schedule, whereas the operator specified 6-hourly (35 */6 * * *) as the replacement for push-on-main to restore intended coverage
The "28x cost increase" rationale cited in codeql.yml header is no longer valid because navapbc/rebar is a public repository where CodeQL and GitHub Actions minutes are free

CodeQL must remain on schedule-only (no push trigger to main) and cannot join the existing _SIX_HOURLY cohort wholesale because that tuple also drives push-preservation assertions for non-main branches

The four 6-hourly scheduled lanes (test.yml :41, optionality.yml :47, verify-identity.yml :53, codeql.yml :35) must use distinct off-the-hour minutes to prevent GitHub scheduler congestion at the hour boundary
